test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

The committee recommended / that the bill / be passed immediately.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentences provided are perfectly grammatical and do not contain an error, thus the choice **'No error' **applies in this case.
 
• The original sentence, "The committee recommended that the bill be passed immediately", follows the correct structure of subject + recommended that + noun clause.
 
• Hence, the sentence is grammatically correct, making 'No error' the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is - **Option 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In sentences like this, we commonly use the subjunctive form **'be' **after **'recommended that', **irrespective of the subject in the noun clause.
